n: DM NVX® 4K60 4:2:0 Network AV Decoder with Scaler (DM-NVX-D200)
d: DM-NVX-D200 DM NVX® 4K60 4:2:0 Network AV Decoder with Scaler

specs.label: Stream Type
specs.value: Default support for DM-NVX-E20/E10 Series; Support available for 4K60 4:4:4 encoders when using DM-NVX-D200 supported resolutions

specs.label: Video Resolutions
specs.value: HDMI with Deep Color and 4K60 4:2:0 support

specs.label: Decoding audio formats
specs.value: Multichannel (up to 8-channel LPCM or encoded HBR 7.1 surround sound)

specs.label: Bit Rates
specs.value: Based on the stream received from the encoder

specs.label: Output Signal Types
specs.value: HDMI with Deep Color and 4K60 4:2:0 support (DVI compatible)

specs.label: Audio digital formats
specs.value: Dolby Digital®, Dolby Digital EX, Dolby Digital Plus, Dolby TrueHD, Dolby Atmos, DTS®, DTS ES, DTS 96/24, DTS HD High Res, DTS HD Master Audio, DTS:X, LPCM up to 8 channels
